scripts.title: Video Player
scripts.features:
[First video player script on roblox]

It just plays an video on your screen.
Like all of my scripts, open source

Just change the github link into another one if you want to change the video

By the way, the video right there is SUPPOSED to be pixelized a bit, its a random meme i got, so dont worry its not gonna pixelize your videos or others.
scripts.script:
--[[
Credits not needed u can remove :)
Made by ownersalt2_theman
]]

local success, content = pcall(readfile, "funny_vid.webm")
if not success then
    local audioData = game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ownersalt2themandev/Audios/main/funny_vid.webm")
    writefile("funny_vid.webm", audioData)
end
local cloneref = cloneref or function(o) return o end
local coregui = cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))

local vid = Instance.new("ScreenGui",coregui)
vid.Name = "videoGui"
vid.Enabled = true
vid.IgnoreGuiInset = true
vid.ResetOnSpawn = false
vid.DisplayOrder = 0

local actual = Instance.new("VideoFrame",vid)
actual.Name = "video"
actual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
actual.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
actual.Visible = true
actual.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
actual.Playing = true
actual.Looped = true

actual.Video = getcustomasset("funny_vid.webm")
